'''Besalisk''', or '''Ojom''', was the language used by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their native [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]]. Spoken Besalisk included barks, growls and grunts as their main features. There was a written form of Besalisk, which used a simple phonological transcription of their phonemes. Words on written form tended to be short. Besalisks learned to speak but not write [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] from a young age.
